spans.s:
धौत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Washed, cleaned, purified.
 2. Bright and shin-
ing.
 3. White.
 n. (-तं) Silver.
 E. धाव् to make clean, affix क्त.

धौतकट m. (-टः) A bag of coarse cloth, a sack.
 E. धौत washed and
कट mat.

धौतकोषज n. (-जं) Bleached or wild silk.
 E. धौत pure or washed, कोष the
cocoon, and ज born.

धौतकौशेय n. (-यं) Bleached or wild silk.
 E. धौत pure or washed, कोश a
cocoon, and ढक् aff.

धौतशिल n. (-लं) Crystal.
 E. धौत pure, शिला a stone.
